Quantum Grav."],"published-print":{"date-parts":[[2017,5,4]]},"abstract":"<jats:title>Abstract<\/jats:title>\n                  <jats:p>In this paper we present geometry which has been designed to fit a layperson\u2019s description of a \u2018time machine\u2019. It is a box which allows those within it to travel backwards and forwards through time and space, as interpreted by an external observer. Timelike observers travel within the interior of a \u2018bubble\u2019 of geometry which moves along a circular, acausal trajectory through spacetime. If certain timelike observers inside the bubble maintain a persistent acceleration, their worldlines will close.<\/jats:p>\n                  <jats:p>Our analysis includes a description of the causal structure of our spacetime, as well as a discussion of its physicality. The inclusion of such a bubble in a spacetime will render the background spacetime non-orientable, generating additional consistency constraints for formulations of the initial value problem. The spacetime geometry is geodesically incomplete, contains naked singularities, and requires exotic matter.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1088\/1361-6382\/aa6549","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2017,3,8]],"date-time":"2017-03-08T07:15:10Z","timestamp":1488957310000},"page":"095006","update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1088\/crossmark-policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":9,"title":["Traversable acausal retrograde domains in spacetime"],"prefix":"10.1088","volume":"34","author":[{"given":"Benjamin K","family":"Tippett","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"name":"University of British Columbia"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"David","family":"Tsang","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"University of Maryland"}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"266","published-online":{"date-parts":[[2017,3,31]]},"reference":[{"key":"cqgaa6549bib001","doi-asserted-by":"publisher","first-page":"L73","DOI":"10.1088\/0264-9381\/11\/5\/001","type":"journal-article","article-title":"The warp drive: hyper-fast travel within general relativity","volume":"11","author":"Alcubierre","year":"1994","journal-title":"Class.
